title: fleet-guards: TOCTOU between -f test and stat on pause flag files
description: Codereview of a7p2 fix (edge pass, kimi-k3). Lines 72-73 and 82-83: if .fleet-paused / .fleet-workers-paused is removed between the [ -f ] test and the stat -c %Y substitution, the empty stat output is treated as 0 in arithmetic, PAUSE_AGE/WP_AGE ~= epoch-now > 3600, and a spurious '[ALARM] Pause expired' bd issue is filed (plus rm -f of flags). Low likelihood (single writer), real consequence class. Fix: capture stat output into a variable and test it, or re-test -f after stat.
